        .header {

        .summary-text {

        }

        .job-company {

        }

        .job-details {

            font-size: 0.9rem;
            color: var(--text-main);
        }

        .job-details li {
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            padding-left: 5px;
        }

        }

        }

            color: var(--accent-color);
            font-weight: bold;
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            font-size: 1.2rem;
            line-height: 1.4rem;
        }

        /* --- Print Styles --- */
        @media print {
            body {
                background-color: white;
            }
            .page-container {
                box-shadow: none;
                margin: 0;
                width: 100%;
                max-width: 100%;
                height: auto; 
            }
            
            .page {
                display: flex; /* Maintain flex for columns on the page */
                width: 100%;
                height: auto;
                page-break-after: always; /* Force a break after each defined page block */
                margin: 0;
            }

            /* 1. Force Page 1 to fill exactly one US Letter page */
            #page-one {
                height: 279.4mm; /* US Letter Height */
                overflow: hidden; /* Important: Prevents content from spilling over */
            }

            /* 2. Page 2 and subsequent flow */
            #page-two, #page-three {
                height: 279.4mm; /* Set exact height for print page break */
                min-height: 279.4mm;
                page-break-before: always;

            /* Columns for Page 1 */
            #page-one .left-col {

                flex-shrink: 0;

            #page-two .left-col {

                background-color: var(--sidebar-bg) !important;

            }

            }

            #page-three .left-col {

            /* Set print size to US Letter */

<body>
    
    <div class="page-container">
        <!-- PAGE ONE: Sidebar + Header, Summary, Achievements -->
        <div id="page-one" class="page">
            <!-- Left Column (Sidebar: Contact, Education, Awards, Languages) -->
            <aside class="left-col">
                <div class="contact-info">
                    <div class="sidebar-title">Contact</div>
                    <div class="contact-item">
                        <i class="fas fa-envelope"></i>
                        <a href="mailto:{{ personal_info.contact.email }}">{{ personal_info.contact.email }}</a>
                    </div>
                    <div class="contact-item">
                        <i class="fas fa-phone"></i>
                        <span>{{ personal_info.contact.phone }}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div class="contact-item">
                        <i class="fab fa-linkedin"></i>
                        <a href="{{ personal_info.contact.linkedin }}">{{ personal_info.contact.linkedin | replace('https://','') }}</a>
                    </div>
                    <div class="contact-item">
                        <i class="fas fa-globe"></i>
                        <a href="{{ personal_info.contact.website }}">{{ personal_info.contact.website | replace('https://','') }}</a>
                    </div>
                </div>

                <div class="sidebar-section">
                    <div class="sidebar-title">Education</div>
                    {% for edu in education %}
                    <div class="education-item">
                        <span class="degree">{{ edu.degree }}{% if edu.field %}, {{ edu.field }}{% endif %}</span>
                        <span class="university">{{ edu.institution }}</span>
                        <span class="year">{{ edu.end_year or edu.graduation_date }}</span>
                    </div>
                    {% endfor %}
                </div>

                <div class="sidebar-section">
                    <div class="sidebar-title">Awards</div>
                    {% for award in awards %}
                    <div class="award-item">
                        <span class="degree">{{ award.degree or award.title }}</span>
                        <span class="year">{{ award.year }}</span>
                    </div>
                    {% endfor %}
                </div>

                <div class="sidebar-section">
                    <div class="sidebar-title">Languages</div>
                    <ul class="skill-list">
                        {% for lang in personal_info.languages %}
                        <li>{{ lang }}</li>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </ul>
                </div>
            </aside>

            <!-- Right Column (Main Content: Header, Summary, Achievements) -->
            <main class="right-col">
                <header class="header">
                    <h1 class="name">{{ personal_info.name }}</h1>
                    <div class="job-title">{{ template_metadata.job_title }}</div>
                </header>

                <section class="section">
                    <h2 class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-user-circle"></i> Summary</h2>
                    <p class="summary-text">
                        {{ professional_summary }}
                    </p>
                </section>

                <section class="section">
                    <h2 class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-trophy"></i> Selected Achievements</h2>
                    <ul class="achievement-list">
                        {% for ach in achievements %}
                        <li>{{ ach.text or ach }}</li>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </ul>
                </section>
            </main>
        </div>

        <!-- PAGE TWO: Skills + Experience (Continuation) -->
        <div id="page-two" class="page">
            <!-- Left Column (Skills) -->
            <aside class="left-col">
                <section class="section">
                    <h2 class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-code"></i> Technical Skills</h2>
                    <div class="skills-grid">
                        {% for category, items in skills_by_category.items() %}
                        <div class="skill-group">
                            <h4>{{ category }}</h4>
                            <ul class="skill-list">
                                {% for skill in items %}
                                <li>{{ skill.name }}{% if skill.years %} ({{ skill.years }} yrs){% endif %}</li>
                                {% endfor %}
                            </ul>
                        </div>
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                </section>
            </aside>

            <!-- Right Column (Experience - Retained 4 most recent entries) -->
            <main class="right-col">
                <section class="section">
                    <h2 class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-briefcase"></i> Experience</h2>
                    {% for exp in experiences %}
                    <div class="job-entry">
                        <div class="job-header">
                            <div class="job-role">{{ exp.title }}</div>
                            <div class="job-company">{{ exp.company }}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="job-dates">{{ exp.start_date }} – {{ exp.end_date }}</div>
                        {% if exp.achievements %}
                        <ul class="job-details">
                            {% for ac in exp.achievements %}
                            <li>{{ ac.text or ac }}</li>
                            {% endfor %}
                        </ul>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                    {% endfor %}
                </section>
            </main>
        </div>
        
        <!-- PAGE THREE: Skills Continuation + Experience Continuation -->
        <div id="page-three" class="page">
             <!-- Left Column (Skills Continuation) -->
             <aside class="left-col">
                <section class="section">
                    <h2 class="section-title"><i class="fas fa-code"></i> Technical Skills</h2>
                    <div class="skills-grid">
                        {% for category, items in skills_by_category.items() %}
                            {% if not loop.first %} {# continue after first page #}
                            <div class="skill-group">
                                <h4>{{ category }}</h4>
                                <ul class="skill-list">
                                    {% for skill in items %}
                                    <li>{{ skill.name }}{% if skill.years %} ({{ skill.years }} yrs){% endif %}</li>
                                    {% endfor %}
                                </ul>
                            </div>
                            {% endif %}
                        {% endfor %}
                    </div>
                </section>
             </aside> 

             <!-- Right Column (Experience Continuation - additional entries) -->
             <main class="right-col">
                <section class="section">
                    {% for exp in experiences[4:] %}
                    <div class="job-entry">
                        <div class="job-header">
                            <div class="job-role">{{ exp.title }}</div>
                            <div class="job-company">{{ exp.company }}</div>
                        </div>
                        <div class="job-dates">{{ exp.start_date }} – {{ exp.end_date }}</div>
                        {% if exp.achievements %}
                        <ul class="job-details">
                            {% for ac in exp.achievements %}
                            <li>{{ ac.text or ac }}</li>
                            {% endfor %}
                        </ul>
                        {% endif %}
                    </div>
                    {% endfor %}
                </section>
             </main>
        </div>
        <!-- END PAGE THREE -->
    </div>

</body>
</html>

        """Validate that a DOCX file was generated correctly."""
        path = Path(file_path)
        if not path.exists():
            print(f"❌ DOCX file not found: {file_path}")
            return False
            
        if path.stat().st_size == 0:
            print(f"❌ DOCX file is empty: {file_path}")
            return False
            
        # Basic DOCX validation - it's a ZIP file
        try:
            import zipfile
            with zipfile.ZipFile(file_path, 'r') as docx:
                # Check for required DOCX structure
                required_files = ['[Content_Types].xml', 'word/document.xml']
                for required_file in required_files:
                    if required_file not in docx.namelist():
                        print(f"❌ DOCX missing required file: {required_file}")
                        return False
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"❌ Error reading DOCX: {e}")
            return False
            
        print(f"✅ DOCX validation passed: {file_path}")
        return True

    @staticmethod
    def validate_html_file(file_path: str, required_snippet: str = None) -> bool:
        """Validate that an HTML file was generated and optionally contains text."""
        path = Path(file_path)
        if not path.exists():
            print(f"❌ HTML file not found: {file_path}")
            return False

        if path.stat().st_size == 0:
            print(f"❌ HTML file is empty: {file_path}")
            return False

        if required_snippet:
            try:
                text = path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
                if required_snippet not in text:
                    print(f"❌ HTML file missing expected text: {required_snippet}")
                    return False
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"❌ Error reading HTML file: {e}")
                return False

        print(f"✅ HTML validation passed: {file_path}")
        return True
